cases.title: Referral page shows the mover, address, dates, services, consent, status, rep, agent, agency, Lead and Opportunity links and Commissions
Commission page shows all its fields; Amount, Rate Applied and Services Count are read-only
Payout Batch page shows its fields, Lines and the console for that batch only
Payout Line page shows agency, ABN, reference, total, count and its Commissions
Partner Referral Lead and Opportunity layouts show the partner referral fields
Partner Referral record type uses the partner layout for every profile that uses it
Partner users still see only the portal components
